title: feat(types): a public block's prop written flat on the node is refused by name, toward its `properties` bag (objectui#10872, batch 10)
body:
Part of #10872
Clause-②: no

Batch 10 of objectui#10872: the flat-props refusal half. A public block's prop written directly on the node, instead of in its `properties` bag, is now refused by name on both faces of `@object-ui/types/zod`, at its own path, with a message naming `properties.KEY`. The card keeps `record:line_items` (no spec row yet) and the six batch-4 arms' `children` narrowing.

Dispatched run, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42`, claim `5933064114` (`domain:ui` seat 2). Draft, left for the seat.

## The ruling this executes

Triage's answer A on objectui#10872 (comment `5906817482`): "The spec's strict page-component schema refuses flat `actionType` / `target` as mis-layered (ADR-0089 D3a)", and "B is not taken. A flat channel in objectui's arms is a second dialect: `objectui validate` would accept what `os validate` refuses." Its precondition, the taught docs moving to the bag, landed with objectui#11183 (completed 2026-10-01). Two teaching sites that move missed are moved here (below).

## Zone 2 readings (measured before the change, objectui `2e060ba`, `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0)

1. **Both faces accepted flat row keys.** Population: every arm of `PublicBlockComponentSchema` and `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` whose `properties` is a spec row: 34 arms. Four of them already refused their flat spelling by name, each with its own map (`object-form`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`: objectui#10859; `object-chart`: objectui#11276). The other 30 (27 public blocks plus `object-metric`, `object-master-detail-form`, `object-timeline`) are this batch. The "29" in the release note was dated: `object-timeline` joined later. Probe: for every row key that is not a node-level key of the spec's page component, `{ type, KEY: v }` for seven values, read per face for an issue at `[KEY]`.
   - Tolerant face (`safeValidateSchema`, what `objectui validate` runs): 26 arms accepted at least one flat row key; 223 keys passed unjudged.
   - Strict face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`): every key `BaseSchema` does not declare was refused, but only as an unnamed `unrecognized_keys`. 14 keys passed outright, judged by `BaseSchema`'s own type, because the row member shares a name with a base key: `visible` (`record:alert`, the four `action:` blocks), `disabled` (`element:button`, `action:button`, `action:icon`), `name` and `description` (`action:button`, `action:icon`), `description` (`object-metric`), `data` (`object-timeline`).
   - After this change: 0 and 0, on all 34 arms.
   - The spec's `PageComponentSchema` refuses every one of those keys on the node (`unrecognized_keys`), and accepts `label`.
2. **The pull.** Instrument: the committed scanner `scripts/body-dialect-census.mjs` (`scanNodes`, `keepFencedCodeOnly`, `bucketOf`) under an uncommitted driver. FLAT = a node-level key that is a member of the type's spec row, is not a node-level key of the spec's page component, and is not already refused by name toward `properties`. ⚠️ Batch 7's dated reading counted only keys the arm leaves undeclared, so it could not see the base-declared row keys (`visible`, `disabled`, `name`, `description`, `data`); this reading counts them.
   - objectstack `main` `454bbb6` (depth-1 scratch clone; the shared checkout was not fetched or edited): 9627 files, 675 nodes of the 30 types (572 carry `properties`), **0 flat nodes in every bucket, tests included**. Lit control on the same corpus and mechanism: node-level `responsiveStyles` on 17 example-app nodes of these types, batch 8's reading.
   - objectui `2e060ba`: 9729 files, 667 nodes of the 30 types. Non-test flat writers: 5 teaching nodes and 8 composed in code.
     - Teaching: `packages/app-shell/README.md` (two `action:button` route examples, flat `actionType`), `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` (one `record:related_list` example, flat `objectName` / `relationshipField` / `columns` / `actions`), and two pending changesets of other cards (`.changeset/10289-action-params-properties.md`, `.changeset/7867-action-params-templates.md`, flat `actionType`). The first two are moved to the bag in this PR; the changesets are not (Acceptance notes).
     - Composed in code, never judged by a zod face: `MasterDetailForm` hosts in `plugin-form` (`ObjectForm`, `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`) and the console's `DevMasterDetail` page (`object-master-detail-form`), `DashboardRenderer` / `DashboardGridLayout` (`object-metric`), `action-bar` (`action:menu`), `ListView` (`object-timeline`). `SchemaRenderer` runs `@object-ui/core`'s structural `validateSchema`, not a zod face, and keeps reading both spellings.
   - After this PR: the two pending changesets are the only non-test teaching writers left.
3. **The precedent fits, generalised.** objectui#11328 (`object-chart`) refuses each bag member written flat with `aliasKeyRefusal(KEY, 'properties.KEY', …)`, one map per arm, as `object-form` / `object-map` / `object-gantt` do. This batch makes that ONE helper, `flatPropRefusals(type, row)` in `public-blocks.zod.ts`, spread into the 26 public-block arms whose row declares a member and into the three ObjectQL arms. It also carries the two exceptions those maps had per arm: a row key the spec's page component declares on the node (`label`, `aria`, `type`) is left alone, as `object-gantt` leaves `label`; and a row member the spec itself retires keeps the row's own retirement when written flat, as `object-chart`'s three retired spellings do (`page:header`'s `icon`, `page:card`'s `actions`, `record:details`' `layout`).
4. **The html tier is not reached.** No non-test path feeds `sdui-parser` output into a zod face. `objectui validate` reads JSON or YAML (`validate.ts`), and `objectui check` globs `**/*.{json,yaml,yml}`. `SchemaRenderer` runs the structural validator, and `packages/sdui-parser` imports no zod face. Seven test files import both tiers; each judges each tier on its own spelling, and all seven are in the sweep below, green. No `packages/sdui-parser` file is touched.
5. **PR objectui#11069.** Its ratchet counts `invalid_union` at `['type']`; no arm joins or leaves, so the count does not move (the `packages/cli` suite, ratchet included, is green). One thing it should account for when it un-parks: on the strict face these flat keys now report `invalid_type` at the key, with the by-name message, instead of `unrecognized_keys`, so its `findUndeclaredKeys` (which reads `unrecognized_keys`) will not list them on its undeclared-key line. The zod message names each one.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/zod/public-blocks.zod.ts`: `flatPropRefusals` and its message composer; `PAGE_COMPONENT_NODE_KEYS`, the spec page component's node-level keys (transcribed; the pin re-derives them from the installed spec's own shape); one spread line in each of the 26 arms, placed BEFORE the arm's own members, so an arm's own refusal of a row key keeps its message (`record:alert`'s `body`, the `action:` controls' `onSuccess`, the content-channel tombstones). Module and `record:alert` docblocks updated.
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: the same spread in `object-metric`, `object-master-detail-form` and `object-timeline`; their docblocks, and the `object-form` sentence "Unlike the blocks above", which this change made false.
- `packages/types/src/zod/README.md`: two lines.
- Nothing at render time moves, and no renderer is touched. The helper is internal: not re-exported from `@object-ui/types/zod`, and the package has no deep `./zod/*` export.

## Producer side (bounded in-place fix, declared)

The two teaching sites objectui#11183's move missed now write the bag: the `record:related_list` actions example in `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`, and the two `action:button` route examples in `packages/app-shell/README.md`. Each migrated snippet parses on both faces and on the spec's page component, and its flat spelling is refused by name (probe, not committed). The four conditions hold: the same defect class as objectui#11183 (taught flat props on a public block); a mechanical move whose shape AGENTS.md #4 pins; no open PR touches either file; docs only, so no new gate surface. Neither file is governed.

## Pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/flat-props-refusal-10872.test.ts` (new): the population read off the live unions, closed over the 30 covered arms plus the four earlier ones; every owed row key refused on both faces for five values, at its own path, with `invalid_type` and a message naming `properties.KEY` (retired members excepted); per arm a RED row (its known-good bag written flat is refused by exactly the owed keys, each named, with no `unrecognized_keys` left) and a GREEN control (the same bag in `properties` parses on both faces); the spec's page component refusing the same flat keys; what is left alone (node-level row keys, retired members by reference, the arms' own refusals); the earlier four arms holding the same invariant; nested nodes in a node-level slot and in a bag child list refused at their own paths.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/held-public-block-arms-10872.test.ts`: the batch-4 CONTROL on the taught node's flat spelling asserted the old state (strict face: an unnamed `unrecognized_keys`; tolerant face: success). It now asserts both faces refuse exactly `actionType` and `target` by name, and keeps the spec reading in its own row.
- Ablation, implementation committed first, through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode plus a shell trap restoring by absolute path. Anchor: the helper's key filter, replaced by a filter that keeps no key (marker `ABLATION-10872-B10`), so no arm gets a generated refusal and every explicit member stays. On disk: anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `42a567fcff9e` to `a6e95cc943d1`. Result: `Tests  258 failed | 145 passed (403)`, red as predicted. The red rows: 223 per-key rows (the base probe's 223), 26 per-arm RED rows (all but `element:divider` and the three thin `page:` containers, whose only owed key is overridden), 3 retired-member rows, 4 nested rows, 2 batch-4 CONTROL rows. All GREEN controls stayed green. Restore: blob after restore == HEAD blob `42a567fcff9e`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The target and both pin files are blob-identical between the ablation commit `2cc5b0e` and the head.
- Reverse type check through the rebuilt dist: a scratch file in `packages/cli` (resolving `@object-ui/types/zod` to `packages/types/dist/zod/index.zod.d.ts`) assigning `{ type: 'action:button', actionType: 'url' }` to the arm's input type got exactly one error, `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`, on that line. The bag spelling compiled. The file was deleted, and the type-check is clean again. A first attempt imported `zod`, which `packages/cli` does not depend on, and failed on TS2307 instead: it measured nothing and is not counted.

## Gates (head `401d406`, after merging `main` at `8673402a3f`, which carries objectui#11384, objectui#11385, objectui#11386 and objectui#11387)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`: dist completeness 1 package complete. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0 (its test program lists both pin files). One lock hold with these two and the next two joined by `&&`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files  316 passed (316)`, `Tests  8371 passed (8371)`. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/`: `24 passed (24)`, `338 passed (338)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check`: exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/cli^...' build` (9 of 47 projects; the rebuilt `public-blocks.zod.d.ts` carries the helper). `packages/cli` is the one package whose source reads these arms' types.
- Consumer sweep, 168 test files outside `packages/types` (re-derived after the last merge): every test naming a face, an arm, `@object-ui/types/zod`, the edited markdown or a changeset reader, plus the cli suite and the arm-list consumers the batch-1 ruling names. `81 passed (81)` / `1847 passed` and `87 passed (87)` / `2126 passed`. The same matrix was green at `da80d90` before the last merge (166 files, 3955 tests).
- Exit 0: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only; it skips `zod/`), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset declared), `changeset:check`, `check:handler-key-reads` (140 arms, 56 judged), `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; 23 pending changesets naming a touched file, each read; the four this change falsifies get dated notes, below), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` (all adjudicated), `check:doc-types`, `check-doc-links`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`, both exit 2, PRECONDITION NOT MET (34 packages unbuilt). This diff changes no `ts` / `tsx` fence and no `@example`, and no doc fence references a public-block arm's type. CI builds and runs both. Also NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports` (needs every package's dist); the README edits add no fence or import.
- eslint, declared narrowing: the 4 changed TS files, `--no-inline-config --format json`: 4 files, 0 errors, 1 warning, a pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `objectql.zod.ts` outside this diff's hunks. `--print-config` shows no `project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and no untouched file's verdict can move. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 12 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Changesets

- `.changeset/10872-flat-props-refusal.md`: `'@object-ui/types': minor`, the objectui#11328 and batch-5/6 precedent. The arms are unreleased (`@object-ui/types` 17.6.0 on npm has no public-block arm: 0 hits for `PublicBlockComponentSchema` in its dist, against 4 for `AnyComponentSchema`), so across the release the accept set for these types only widens.
- Dated notes, frontmatter byte-identical (md5 of the first four lines unchanged): `10872-public-block-zod-arms.md`, `10872-held-public-block-arms.md`, `10859-object-timeline-zod-arm.md`, `10859-pivot-object-block-zod-arms.md`. Each stated that a flat key passes the tolerant face unjudged, or that a base-declared row key is judged by the base.
- `Clause-②: no` is the claim's line. The criterion is whether the card widens an accept set or the public surface, and this one only refuses. The precedent batches 5 and 6 and objectui#11328 declared their narrowings `yes`; that difference is recorded for the seat rather than chosen silently.

## objectui#11385 (landed as `304f611379` during this batch; merged into this branch at `401d406`)

No shared file. Its `PublicBlockNode` is each arm's own `z.input` read off the arm's shape, so the TS authoring types and these zod faces describe the same bag by construction. Its pins run on the merged tree and pass: `authoring-nodes-11364.test.ts` is in the `types` test program (type-check exit 0) and in the `types` vitest run. Its two `@ts-expect-error` rows on flat `items` and flat `actionType` stay needed. A type probe against this branch (scratch, deleted; a deliberately false control proved the file was in the program) found that no arm's closed input carries an index signature. Flat `actionType`, `visible` and `title` type as `undefined`, `label` stays a node key, and the bag spelling compiles. Its `SchemaRenderer` hunk is type-only (the `schema` prop union), so the hoist this batch relies on is unchanged.

⚠️ **One disagreement, recorded rather than repaired (its files are not this batch's).** The landed `authoring-nodes.ts` builds `ElementTextInputNode` and `ElementRecordPickerNode`, the two spec-row blocks with no zod arm, "the way every arm is built": `BaseSchema.extend({ type, ...NODE_ENVELOPE, properties, body, children })`. After this batch every arm also spreads `flatPropRefusals`, so those two TS types are the one place the bag shape differs. A base-declared row key written flat type-checks there: `placeholder`, `disabled` and `description` on `element:text_input`, and `placeholder` on `element:record_picker` (probe against the installed rows). Their other row keys written flat are refused, but only as excess properties, not by name. No validator disagrees today: `AnyComponentSchema` refuses both types at `type`. When those two get zod arms, the arms should spread `flatPropRefusals`, and the TS types can then derive from the arms.

## Acceptance notes

- Two pending changesets of other cards teach the flat `actionType` on `action:button` in their examples: `.changeset/10289-action-params-properties.md` (its Migration block) and `.changeset/7867-action-params-templates.md`. Their claims are about the runtime and stay true, but the examples will freeze into the CHANGELOG at release teaching a spelling `objectui validate` now refuses. Not edited here; carrier: the seat (a dated note before the release, objectui#11183's family).
- `object-form`, `object-map`, `object-gantt` and `object-chart` keep their own per-arm maps and messages; folding them into `flatPropRefusals` would change their messages, on cards held out of this round. Carrier: objectui#10859 / objectui#11276.
- `AGENTS.md` #4 and `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` say objectui's strict face refuses the flat `actionType` / `target`; both faces now do. The sentence stays true, so no governed file is touched.
- The eight in-code composers above still build flat nodes. They are the node as the renderer reads it after the hoist, not authored documents, and no zod face judges them.
